requirements.name: aip-v0.2/challenge-response-replay

specRefs.section: §5.1 Challenge-Response Protocol — step 5: nonce not reused

requirements.description: An AIP §5.1 challenge-response transcript that reuses a nonce the verifier has already seen. The signature is mathematically valid, the publicKey matches the agentDid's bound key, the challenge is not expired — but the nonce appears in verifierState.seenNonces, modelling 'a prior verification already consumed this nonce.' Verifier MUST REJECT with NONCE_REPLAY.

requirements.name: aip-v0.2/challenge-response-stale-challenge

specRefs.section: §5.1 Challenge-Response Protocol — step 5: challenge not expired (5-minute window)

requirements.description: An AIP §5.1 challenge-response transcript where the challenge expired before the verifier's pinned clock. expiresAt is 25 minutes earlier than verifierState.clockRfc3339. The signature is otherwise mathematically valid and made by the agent's bound key. Verifier MUST REJECT with CHALLENGE_EXPIRED.

requirements.name: aip-v0.2/challenge-response-valid
requirements.description: A well-formed AIP §5.1 challenge-response transcript. The IdP-issued challenge is bound to the agent's DID, the agent has signed the canonical 5-field payload with its bound key, the publicKey returned in the response matches the agentDid's bound key in verifierState, the nonce is unseen, and the challenge has not expired against the pinned verifier clock. Verifier MUST ACCEPT.

requirements.name: aip-v0.2/challenge-response-wrong-key

specRefs.section: §5.1 Challenge-Response Protocol — step 5: publicKey matches registered agent

requirements.description: An AIP §5.1 challenge-response transcript where the agent signed with a key NOT bound to its DID. The signature is mathematically valid Ed25519, but the publicKey returned in the response does not match the bound key declared for testAgentDID in verifierState.agentBindings. Verifier MUST REJECT with UNTRUSTED_KEY.

requirements.name: aip-v0.3/trust-score-measured-at-included-weight-0.50

specRefs.section: §6.1 Multi-Factor Algorithm — unscored state: the threshold is strict (0.50 is measured)

requirements.description: An AIP §6.1 composition sitting exactly on the threshold: verification, uptime and executionIsolation carry data (weights 25, 15 and 10), so includedWeight is 0.50, which is not below 0.50. The verifier MUST reach scoreStatus measured: weighted sum 0.41, renormalised 0.82, neutral-imputed ceiling 0.66, published score 0.66.

requirements.name: aip-v0.3/trust-score-measured-six-factors-capped

specRefs.section: §6.1 Multi-Factor Algorithm — exclusion, redistribution and the anti-gaming ceiling

requirements.description: An AIP §6.1 composition with the six measured factors of the reference implementation carrying data and the three proposed factors excluded: includedWeight 0.85, measured. The weighted sum over the included factors is 0.735; renormalised over 0.85 it is 0.8647, and the neutral-imputed ceiling (0.735 plus 0.15 at 0.5) is 0.81, so the published score is the lower value 0.81. The verifier MUST reach scoreStatus measured with score 0.81.

requirements.name: aip-v0.3/trust-score-unscored-zero-event-agent

specRefs.section: §6.1 Multi-Factor Algorithm — unscored state: includedWeight below 0.50

requirements.description: An AIP §6.1 composition for an agent with no verification events: verification, uptime and successRate have no data (confidence 0), and the three proposed factors (compliance, driftDetection, userFeedback) are unmeasured. Only securityAlerts, executionIsolation and age carry data, so includedWeight is 0.30. Under the unscored rule the verifier MUST reach scoreStatus unscored with score null and unscoredReason insufficient_data. The composition rule alone (exclusion, redistribution, neutral-imputed ceiling) would publish 0.575 here, which is the number the rule exists to withhold.
